ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a ~50/50 split between high-intensity white background pixels and low-intensity black mottled clusters across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of irregular black macro-mottling across the central and medial regions of both lobes, with white high-intensity zones concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 75-degree aperture and shallow bounding box depth relative to the total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge, with significant jagged protrusions and pixel-amplitude variations near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into sharp, slightly elevated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated clusters of high-contrast white circular ring-shaped scars (halos) overlaid on the black pigmentation zones, specifically concentrated in the central-medial regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of live barnacles and associated calcified scars along the peripheral leading and trailing edges, particularly heavy at the outer distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ocelli' or leopard-like spotting pattern created by the intersection of circular white scars and dark pigmentation patches.
